properties.PRE_REMEDIAL_MEASURES: Unstable debris material on the upslope as well as along the slide course needs to be removed, No settlement should be allowed on the near vicinity and across the slide course/Nala, natural flow path of nala should not be blocked by any kind of human act
properties.GEOSCIENTIFIC_CAUSE: Continuous heavy rainfall for past 3 days  increased pore water pressure and decreased shear strength of the slope forming material  resulting in  slope failure, heavy discharge of water and debris along the seasonal nala.
